figures.title: From identity to three learned views
figures.purpose: Lookup copies a selected row; normalization rescales it; three projections produce distinct activations.
figures.caption: Lookup copies a selected row; normalization rescales it; three projections produce distinct activations. E [3,4], token 1 selects x [4]. x̂ᵢ = xᵢwᵢ / √(Σⱼxⱼ²/4 + ε). Q [2,2], K [2,2], V [2,2]; no position yet.

figures.title: Heads regroup values without moving them
figures.purpose: A canonical flat vector [4] becomes [2,2]; head coordinates map to the same four elements.
figures.caption: A canonical flat vector [4] becomes [2,2]; head coordinates map to the same four elements. D = 4, H = 2, Dₕ = 2. offset(h,j) = h × 2 + j. No arithmetic, allocation or transpose is implied by this view.

figures.title: Position becomes a rotation
figures.purpose: One pair rotates by pω while its length stays one. Apply the positional transform to Q and K.
figures.caption: One pair rotates by pω while its length stays one. Apply the positional transform to Q and K. one pair x = (1,0); ω = π/6. R(θ)x = (x₀ cosθ − x₁ sinθ, x₀ sinθ + x₁ cosθ). θ = pω; p = 0,1,2,3; V is unchanged.
figures.alt: One pair rotates by pω while its length stays one. Apply the positional transform to Q and K. one pair x = (1,0); ω = π/6; R(θ)x = (x₀ cosθ − x₁ sinθ, x₀ sinθ + x₁ cosθ); θ = pω; p = 0,1,2,3; V is unchanged

figures.title: Compatibility becomes a weighted value
figures.purpose: One query scores two visible keys, normalizes scores and combines corresponding value rows.
figures.caption: One query scores two visible keys, normalizes scores and combines corresponding value rows. q [2], K [3,2], V [3,2]; query position t = 1. scores = Kq / √2; future position 2 is masked. α = softmax(scores + mask); output = Σⱼ αⱼVⱼ.
figures.alt: One query scores two visible keys, normalizes scores and combines corresponding value rows. q [2], K [3,2], V [3,2]; query position t = 1; scores = Kq / √2; future position 2 is masked; α = softmax(scores + mask); output = Σⱼ αⱼVⱼ

figures.title: Cache growth preserves the prefix
figures.purpose: A single layer stores one K and V row for each processed token; each append extends the valid prefix.
figures.caption: A single layer stores one K and V row for each processed token; each append extends the valid prefix. L = 1, Hkv = 1, Dₕ = 2, F32. payload(T) = 2 × L × T × Hkv × Dₕ × 4 bytes. T = 1,2,3,4 → 16,32,48,64 bytes.

figures.title: One worker owns the context
figures.purpose: Requests enter a queue; the worker builds a mixed batch, invokes decode, samples and streams results.
figures.caption: Requests enter a queue; the worker builds a mixed batch, invokes decode, samples and streams results. CURRENT default path; simplified successful iteration. Worker owns Context and Batch; API does not call kernels directly. Error/cancel: finalize affected request; no later token emission.
